releases.name: HyperCore: Rhythm Bullet Hell
releases.summary:
HyperCore is a "Rhythm bullet hell", mixing the frenetic action of classic bullet hell shoot'em up with semi-procedurally generated encounters based on the music.

Survive by avoiding the countless obstacles sent towards them by the core in sync with the music.

releases.name: Crown Chase
releases.summary: Crown Chase is a fast-paced multiplayer party game where you compete against friends to grab and hold the magical crown. Run, dash, and use unique abilities in stylized 3D arenas to outsmart your opponents and claim the ultimate victory.

releases.name: Corner King: Boxing Tycoon
releases.summary:
Run your own boxing gym in a deep sports management sim. 

Scout talent, build champions, handle contracts, rivalries, injuries, and title shots - then guide your fighter live from the corner when the bell rings.

releases.name: REKA
releases.summary: Channel your inner witch! Build your cozy chicken-legged hut, practice witchcraft, and forage for ingredients in autumnal woodlands. Solve quests & uncover the great mysteries of the legendary witch Baba Jaga…

releases.name: Twisted Tower
releases.summary:
Fight off a horrifying cult in the Garden of Eden in search of your wayward daughter, Eve.

- Explore a vast, creepy castle.
- Fight your way through dozens of monstrous cultists.
- Gain new guns, weapons, and abilities.
- Enjoy a fast paced classic shooter inspired by Half-Life and Resident Evil.
- Uncover the mysterious history of The Garden of Eden.
- Ascend into the sky.

releases.name: The Sudoku Way
releases.summary: A Sudoku game that looks, feels, sounds and plays amazing no matter your controller of choice - wrapped in a spectacular Japanese aesthetic. Every puzzle is evaluated for its logical solving experience Over 40 achievements, a career mode with leaderboard and free play. With cloud save support.

releases.name: Dark Bone Prison
releases.summary: Dark Bone Prison is a gothic roguelike dungeon crawler where you forge bone weapons, battle undead horrors, and escape the eternal dark prison. Craft over 100 unique bone weapons in a procedurally generated dungeon. Every run offers new combinations, new horrors, and new ways to survive the darkness

releases.name: Drift Mania
releases.summary: No brakes. No reverse. Just drift control. Master short precision courses, chase ghosts and leaderboards, build custom tracks, and turn messy attempts into clean time-attack runs.

releases.name: Moho-Moho DX
releases.summary: "Moho-Moho DX" is a new puzzle game where you place falling color blocks by looking at the finished picture to recreate it.Featuring 333 stages and 3 modes: relaxing "FIX", challenging "SIMILAR", and mirrored "MIRROR". Plus time attacks, custom stage sharing, and infinite generated stages!

releases.name: Crystaria Online
releases.summary: Return to the 90's! A free to play text-based MMORPG you can play anywhere. Climb from level 1 to 20,000 through dungeons, raids, a shifting labyrinth and a sky of floating islands. 18 classes, deep crafting, guild wars fought with crafted supplies — and a living realm shared with everyone online.

releases.name: Stick Legion
releases.summary: Your income isn't a spreadsheet - it's a battle line. Muster warbands, carve across eight realms, then dock the war in a screen corner and fight on while you work - Order the Last Charge, strengthen your Elders, run it back. Pay once. No ads.
